scope: Proposed input verified against existing helper; this file does not run or validate physical simulation

model.omitted: CAD first module/front2 yaw, wheel spin and wheel-ground collision; not the complete V6 robot

command.startup: Existing linear amplitude ramp over first 20 percent of period; only C0 continuous
command.startup_arg: --joint-startup-s belongs to v6-snake and is not used by phase-sine

motor.provenance: Explicit V6 MuJoCo servo abstraction; passive damping is outside motor saturation; not experimentally calibrated

verification.GIF_loop_note: Initial zero-ramp state differs from the final phase; two computed cycles do not establish steady dynamics
